params.name: subdomain
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified institution

params.name: sort
params.description:
Optional comma-separated string of fields to sort on.
Include a leading dash for descending order.

Available fields:
  * updated_at
  * -updated_at

params.name: location_id
params.description: Filter for specific location. Cannot be used as the only filter — combine it with at least one other filter

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Procedures updated at or after the specified time (UTC). The comparison is inclusive, so a record whose updated_at exactly equals the given value is returned

params.name: started_after
params.description: Filter for procedures with start_date after a specific date (including the date)

params.name: started_before
params.description: Filter for procedures with start_date before a specific date (including the date)

params.name: ended_after
params.description: Filter for procedures with end_date after a specific date (including the date)

params.name: ended_before
params.description: Filter for procedures with end_date before a specific date (including the date)

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: First item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: end_cursor
params.description: Last item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return per page. Maximum allowed amount is 1000.

items.docs:
This endpoint returns a list of procedures.
 You can filter by provider_id, patient_id, appointment_id, started_after, started_before, ended_after, ended_before or
 updated_since. You must provide at least one filter. You may additionally narrow any of these filters by location_id,
 but location_id alone does not satisfy the at-least-one-filter requirement.

params.name: subdomain
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified institution

items.docs: This endpoint returns a single procedure by its NexHealth id. Note: the list endpoint is not filtered by your token's location access, so ids returned by GET /procedures may return 404 here if the procedure belongs to a location your token cannot access or has no location assigned.
